GOAL: Repair R2-MAC-001 on all BODY paths with actual collector projection semantics.
Enable explicit, currently revalidated historical source reuse with an independent frozen-input anchor; never fabricate historical promotion evidence.
Preserve received Mac OCR/cache and appendix PASS evidence; deliver exact incremental source and bounded reacceptance instructions.
ROOT_ROLE: coordination, architecture, provenance, packaging, Git delivery and status; no business-code changes or duplicate product review
FORBIDDEN: Modification of original Mac run, images, OCR, market data or prior frozen R1/R2 evidence
Replacing collector, OCR engine or Drive client
Forged old ATTEMPT/PROMOTION receipt or acceptance from self-reported summary alone
Rerunning unchanged broad appendix/OCR/full test suites without a concrete changed dependency or new risk
Second product writer or second product review verdict from coordinator
PASS_CRITERIA: Mac supplied reproduction rejects omitted image manifest with text and accepts exact collector projection.
Targeted red-to-green regressions cover image completeness and source trust counterexamples.
Explicit legacy adoption validates trusted frozen-input identity and unchanged current artifacts; normal unbound runs stay rejected.
Independent reviewer reruns final exact candidate SHA; distinct Linux and actual Mac labels.
Patch applies and reverses to exact declared bytes; published Git blobs match.
Rebound fixture uses actual runner -> prepare_ocr; existing OCR bytes remain unchanged and invalid rebinding is rejected.
STOP_CONDITIONS: Unverified source identity or package bytes: fail closed with concrete evidence, no network fallback to manufacture success.
New material change outside allowed paths: writer reports evidence and root records scope revision.
Drive raw-byte attempt remains bounded; HTTP403/code1010 is preserved without guessing permissions.
